title: The chain's write diagnostics keep faults from every check group in turn; picture and plugin refusals carry finer kind codes
steps: S1: In the TCH checkout with dependencies installed, run run.cmd.
S2: Confirm every test named in run.tests reports ok.
expect: Faults are taken in turn from every group, so a small group listed late is kept.

A picture left out is sorted into its own kind (left empty, too narrow, no image slot, not transparent, repeated in its block, source gone, twin), and a plugin refusal carries the plugin's error code.

tests: the faults kept are taken in turn from every group, so a group listed late is seen too
a plugin refusal carries the plugin's own error code
an item the write step left out is sorted by why it had nothing to write to
